transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening.  
Just avoid heavy work or anything strenuous for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you! Yes, I was wondering when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops or treatment before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s helpful, thanks. I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses when you go outside.

But strong pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one more. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, it may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Some light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts to the new lens." It also conveyed `mild_case_advice` with "If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses when you go outside." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by "But strong pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful." All points were substantively conveyed.
